description: Today at the gym I listened to an interview of Democratic National Committe chair Ken Martin on Pod Save America. I'd heard references to it on other shows, so I wanted to check it out for myself. Let's just say, it wasn't the kind of discussion to fill Democrats with confidence. The main topic was the release of the DNC's "autopsy" report on the 2024 election, which Martin had promised to release.
